The registry holds each template's markdown and prompt leads separately, so both match, and both line numbers are reported in ascending order. Reporting only the first would leave the second in the analyst payload. One export record carries one kind, and nothing above this fixture fixes which kind wins when a body matches both. The pin is: kind is the first matched line's kind in body order, which is markdown here.
